### Onboarding Process
The onboarding process is owned by **People Operations** and applies to all new hires regardless of grade. Here is a summary:

- **Before Day One:** New hires receive a welcome pack one week prior to their start date, are set up with IT equipment and accounts, and are assigned an onboarding buddy (at the same grade or one grade above).
- **Week One:**
  - **Day 1:** Orientation, benefits enrollment, and meeting with their onboarding buddy
  - **Day 2:** Mandatory data security training *(must be completed before accessing any client data)*
  - **Days 3–5:** Delivery methodology, timesheet/billable hours rules, and expense policy
  - **New Managers & Partners** also meet with the Managing Partner during week one
- **Project Assignment:** New consultants are assigned to their first project by the end of **week two**. Analysts and Consultants cannot be the sole consultant on a project during their **first 90 days**.
- **Check-ins:** Formal check-ins occur at **30, 60, and 90 days**, with onboarding officially completing upon sign-off of the 90-day check-in.

This information came from the **Retrieval Agent**.
